x: The sprinters did well with Basil Walden defeating the holder C. Gibbs, to win the 100 yards, with D Merrett 3rd and J.
Needless to say we celebrated our win in the proper manner on our return to London. Heartiest congratulations must go to D.
The outstanding performances were D.Merrett who returned 51.4secs for the quarter mile, J. Masters 9mins.28secs 2 miles run in 5th position and R.
Another personal best time was that of Len Bishop who returned 4m. 21s. in finishing 3rd in the mile. D. Merrett finished 3rd in both sprint finals and Jock Cameron was 2nd in the 440 yards with C.
